docs.title: SEA Service Team Reports
docs.text: Welcome to the central repository for the SEA Service Team's monthly performance, training, and operational reports. The data presented in these monthly summaries is consolidated directly from our primary Salesforce dashboards and live tracking sheets.

docs.title: Live Data Sources
docs.text:
The monthly metrics are pulled directly from the following live reporting environments, including our localized Salesforce trackers and global HQ analytics. Use the links below to access real-time data, verify organizational alignment, or perform independent deep dives.

docs.text:
Special Note: Business Hour FRT Target

9 cases missed the 2-hour response time during business hours, resulting in a 5.73% miss rate.

Action Required: Ensure this metric stays below 5% moving forward. Please pay attention when busy with other support calls.

docs.title: SEA Service Team Report: February 2026 Summary
Key Performance Indicators
docs.text: Metric Value Status / Trend Total Cases (YTD) 306 -0.14% vs 2025 Missed SLA (<2h) 19 6.21% Miss Rate (Goal <5%) FRT < 2h (Goal: 80%) 81.05% Target Met Helpdesk NPS 92.9 On 14 responses (4.6%)

docs.title: Key Summary & Observations
docs.text:
Special Note: Business Hour FRT Target

19 cases missed the 2-hour response time during business hours, resulting in a 6.21% miss rate, exceeding our 5% tolerance.

Action Required: Staff are urged to seek immediate capacity support when occupied with complex phone tickets to better manage the email queue.

  • Seasonal Volume Dip: YTD cases reached 306, a slight YoY drop of -0.14%. February volume dropped due to the festive season. A March volume spike is forecasted due to MFA implementation.
  • FRT Target Met: First Response Time (FRT) < 2hrs achieved 81.05%, maintaining performance above the 80% corporate target. Speed performance decreased slightly from January's 82.4%.
  • Excellent NPS Score: Customer satisfaction remains exceptionally high, far exceeding the 60.0 benchmark. NPS stands at 92.9 with a CES of 6.9, based on 14 surveys.
  • Channel & Product Mix: Email dominance continues at 86.93% (266 cases). Tekla Structural Designer (143 cases) and Tekla Structures (125 cases) ratio returned to the standard 60:40.

docs.title: SEA Service Team Report: March 2026 Summary
Key Performance Indicators
docs.text: Metric Value Status / Trend Total Cases (YTD) 468 -0.07% vs 2025 Missed SLA (<2h) 32 7.84% Miss Rate (Goal <5%) FRT < 2h (Goal: 80%) 80.34% Target Met Helpdesk NPS 84.9 On 33 responses

docs.title: Key Summary & Observations
docs.text:
Special Note: Business Hour FRT Target

32 cases missed the 2-hour response time during business hours (excluding 60 cases outside office hours/weekends), resulting in a 7.84% miss rate out of 408 valid cases.

Action Required: Staff are urged to seek immediate capacity support when occupied with complex phone tickets to better manage the email queue.

  • Volume Trend (February vs. March): YTD cases reached 468. February recorded 127 cases, experiencing a drop due to the festive season. As of March 30, March has 136 closed and pending cases, comfortably exceeding February's total.
  • FRT Target Performance: First Response Time (FRT) < 2hrs achieved 80.34%, maintaining performance just above the 80% corporate target.
  • NPS & Customer Satisfaction: Customer satisfaction remains exceptionally high, far exceeding the 60.0 benchmark. NPS stands at 84.9 with a CES of 6.8, based on 33 surveys.
  • Additional Operational Metrics: Knowledge Reuse reached 12.61%, Resolution under 3 days was 38.03%, and the Escalation Rate was kept low at 2.37% across 185 unique accounts.
